claims.explanation: Repaglinide is a meglitinide insulin secretagogue that closes ATP-sensitive potassium (KATP) channels by binding the SUR1/KCNJ11 complex, and it also inhibits OATP transporters and CYP2C8. The selective killing pattern is best explained by expression of the drug's targets (ABCC8/SUR1, KCNJ11/Kir6.2) and uptake/efflux transporters (SLCO1B1/OATP1B1, ABCC8) in tumor cells, with PTEN loss and PI3K/AKT pathway activation sensitizing cells to KATP-channel-mediated apoptosis. Lines with PTEN mutations and high KATP-channel subunit expression are enriched among sensitive lines, whereas NRAS/BRAF-mutant lines with low target expression are protected.
